<center>
*The science and practice of designing and deploying machine learning systems that are fair, interpretable, and privacy-preserving.*
</center>

<br>

<div class="row">
  <div class="col" markdown="1">

  **Instructor**: [Lucas Rosenblatt]([INSTRUCTOR_URL]). Please call me Lucas.

  **Class Times**: [MEETING_TIMES] in [ROOM].

  **Office Hours**: [OFFICE_HOURS] in [OFFICE_LOCATION].

  **Homework**: Problem sets covering technical and conceptual material, graded for completion. Designed to build intuition and prepare for exams and the project.

  </div>
  <div class="col" markdown="1">

  **Labs**: Alternating problem weeks and presentation weeks, in permanent groups of three. See the [Labs](labs.html) page.

  **Quizzes**: Short 10-minute quizzes on Mondays covering the prior week's lectures. ~12 total; 10 points needed for full credit.

  **Exams**: Two exams (midterm + final), each with multiple-choice/true-false and lab-style problem sections.

  **Project**: Semester-long project in groups of two — GitHub repo, 4-page workshop paper, and 10-minute class presentation. See the [Project](project.html) page.

  </div>
</div>

**Resources**: [RESOURCES]
